question: Pandit Acchan Maharaj was a Kathak legend of which of the following gharanas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lucknow.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Acchan Maharaj** was a prominent figure in the **Lucknow **Gharana of Kathak.
 
• He was born into the Kalka-Bindadin family, known for its significant contributions to Kathak.
 
• He is Known for his graceful and emotive style, emphasizing abhinaya (expression), lyrical movements, and intricate footwork.
 
• Father of Pandit Birju Maharaj, who further popularized the Lucknow Gharana on the global stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kathak**

 
 
• ​Kathak is a classical dance form from Northern India, originating from the ancient storytelling traditions of the Kathakars or storytellers.
 
 
 
• **Key elements**
 
 
• **Nritta:** Pure dance focusing on rhythmic and technical aspects.
 
• **Nritya:** Expressive dance that includes storytelling through gestures and facial expressions.
 
• **Natya:** Dramatic performance involving dance, music, and dialogue.
 
 
 
• **Famous Dancers:**
 
 
• **Pandit Birju Maharaj:** Renowned for his contribution to the **Lucknow Gharana** and global promotion of Kathak.
 
• **Sitara Devi:** Celebrated for her contributions to the **Benaras Gharana** and her dramatic performances.
 
• **Kundan Lal Gangani:** Prominent figure of the **Jaipur Gharana**, known for his strong footwork and intricate spins.
